about: Tests CI may skip. scripts/ci/check_skips.py fails the test job when any other test is skipped. Every entry needs a reason; keep it short and narrow (one test, and the OS or Python version where the skip is expected). Scanner, ssh-keygen and git tests are never on this list: CI installs those tools.

allowed.reason: The pinned Hypothesis (6.170) needs Python 3.11 or newer, so requirements-dev.txt does not install it on 3.10 and the fuzz test skips there. It runs on 3.12 and 3.13.
